none: PAS BH-1F0F33: Roman coin: Nummus (Follis) of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Hertfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn, corroded and bent copper-alloy Nummus (Follis) of Constantine I; GENIO POP ROM reverse type; AD 307-318. Roman Imperial Coinage does not list an example where this obverse legend and mintmark appear on the same coin and so precise dating is therefore not possible. It measures 22.1mm in diameter, 1.2mm thick and weighs 2.83g
